meta.title: Anto x Luca — Italian women's handbags
meta.description: A small selection of handbags made in Italy. Clear prices and early access for Bulgaria.
meta.ogDescription: Italian elegance for every day. Join early access.

hero.title: Italian elegance for every day.
hero.subtitle: A small selection of handbags with clear prices. Join first — before the official launch.

collection.title: Six models. No noise.
collection.subtitle: A small selection, each in several colours. Prices are clear. Choose the one you want to see first.

whyItaly.title: Why Italy matters.
whyItaly.p1: We work directly with an Italian maker. We want craftsmanship you can feel in the stitching, the weight of the hardware, and how the bag holds its shape over time — not just a “Made in Italy” label on someone else’s story.
whyItaly.p2: We will share materials and construction with concrete facts once they are finalized with the manufacturer. Until then, we promise only what we can stand behind.
whyItaly.li2: Approach: a small, carefully chosen selection
whyItaly.li3: Promise: clear facts instead of loud superlatives

details.title: What you know today.
details.subtitle: Full specifications will be published before orders open. Until then — silhouette, purpose, and price, with no invented specs.

lifestyle.eyebrow: In the rhythm of the day
lifestyle.title: For your life — not only the display window.
lifestyle.subtitle: Soon you will see the bags in real situations. While we prepare our own photography, we make it clear these are temporary visuals — no stock photos presented as ours.

italy.title: Made in Italy
italy.body: Origin is part of the promise — described with facts, not slogans.

support.title: Support in your language
support.body: Customer communication for shoppers in Bulgaria. Contact details will be completed before the campaign.

price.title: Prices without masks
price.body: Prices are shown in euro. What you see here is the price we are talking about.

policies.title: Honest policies
policies.body: Shipping, returns, and payment — published before sales. No fake reviews and no artificial scarcity.

origin.a: In Italy, with our manufacturing partner. Once we finalize the public details about the atelier and region, we will publish them here — clearly and without embellishment.

materials.a: For each model we will describe the material, lining, and hardware once we have final confirmation. We prefer to wait for the facts rather than promise “premium leather” on guesswork.

delivery.a: Delivery times for Bulgaria will be announced before the first orders. Right now we are collecting interest for early access — with no payment.

deliveryCost.a: We will state it clearly at checkout, together with the terms. We work with logistics for Bulgaria and will not hide fees in fine print.

returns.a: Yes — before sales begin we will publish a full returns policy aligned with your consumer rights. It will be readable, not buried in terms and conditions.

damage.q: What if the parcel arrives damaged?
damage.a: You will have a clear way to contact us and request a replacement or return. Exact steps will be described in the terms before launch.

contact.a: Write to the email at the bottom of the page. Phone and company details will be added before the ad campaign so they are accurate and current.

payment.a: You don’t — not yet. This is an early-access signup. Payment methods will be announced when we open orders.

currency.q: Are prices in euro or leva?
currency.a: Prices on the site are in euro (EUR).

fees.a: Not in the advertising and not in how the price is presented. At purchase you will see the product, shipping, and applicable taxes in one place.

difference.a: By silhouette and how you carry them: from a compact city bag to a medium work-and-city shape and a more structured classic. Full dimensions and details will be filled in before launch — for now, choose the one that draws you most.

waitlist.title: Be among the first.
waitlist.subtitle: No payment now. Tell us which model you like — and we will notify you when orders open. The first 20 preorders get 20% off.

waitlist.modalSubtitle: No payment now — just a signup. First 20 preorders: 20% off.
waitlist.offerBody: Join the list now. The first 20 who place a preorder get 20% off when orders open.

footer.tagline: Women’s handbags made in Italy. For women in Bulgaria who want clean style without the noise.
footer.companyNote: Company details and phone will be added before sales begin.

consent.body: We use necessary cookies for the site to work. Analytics and marketing cookies (Google Analytics and Meta Pixel) load only if you agree.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.banner: This text is provisional and will be replaced after review by a Bulgaria / EU legal professional. It is not a final legal document.
privacy.p1: Anto x Luca collects an email address, optional name, and preferred model to provide early access and related messages — only with your consent.
privacy.p2: We process only what is necessary. After legal editing, this page will include: the data controller, legal basis, retention periods, your rights, and how to submit a GDPR request.
privacy.p3: You can unsubscribe from marketing messages at any time via the link in the email once we start sending them.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.banner: Provisional text. The final version will be completed with a legal professional.
cookies.necessaryBody: required for basic site functionality and remembering your consent choice.
cookies.analyticsBody: Google Analytics 4 — only if you agree.
